## History

Samuel expanded his business and hired a female clerk. Later, his brother [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) visited him to ask about a specific boy. Samuel confirmed he had hired a boy answering that description three days prior to run errands.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P7](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0007)_
